title: LongZero: Enhancing Long-Context Reasoning in LLMs from Zero Data
why_read: A reasonably novel self-play RL approach to improve long-context reasoning in LLMs without external training data, relevant to anyone working on LLM training pipelines.
analysis: LongZero trains a language model to generate its own long-context reasoning tasks instead of relying on existing documents or stronger teacher models for training data. It first creates a compact question-answer pair with evidence, then expands that evidence into a long, multi-document context, combining this with retrieval-style tasks trained via reinforcement learning. This addresses a real bottleneck: good long-context training data is scarce and expensive to create by hand. The approach is evaluated against external-corpus baselines on standard long-context benchmarks, showing it's a credible alternative data-generation strategy.
